name: BTC-Direction-V3-Audit
status: Retrospective research on previously inspected history, not a pristine holdout
available_at: UTC close of signal candle t; forecast starts from that completed close, not an intraday quote
refit_frequency: monthly on UTC first day, expanding window
label_purge: Training label_end < refit date; selection label_end < outer year start
regime_prior_strength: 3 * forecast horizon, fixed pseudo-observations; heuristic shrinkage, not independent sample counts
model_selection: At each outer year start, minimize equal-weight mean annual Brier across all completed past inner forecasts; tie-break by declared candidate order. No outer year labels used. Candidate fixed for that year, coefficients refit monthly.
replacement_evidence_gate: Both horizons: nested primary accuracy and Brier improve against historical prior with paired 95% block-bootstrap lower bounds > 0 for all blocks; every outer year Brier <= prior. This tests evidence over prior only, not direct superiority to V1's different target.
stop_rule: One fixed run of these four candidates for each horizon; report failed gates without expanding search or changing parameters
limitations: All frozen historical candles were exposed to earlier research. Nested chronology addresses local leakage, not prior researcher exposure or repeated-research selection bias.
Overlapping labels are dependent. Report every nonoverlapping offset; never choose the best offset.
Bootstrap intervals condition on recorded predictions and do not include all model-selection or regime-change uncertainty.
High-confidence subset accuracy must always be accompanied by coverage; do not optimize thresholds using these results.
Close-to-close forecasts do not validate intraday live-quote forecasts or promise after-cost profits.
No trading strategy, execution, leverage, or price interval coverage claim is made in V3.
Backtest is based on one exchange and BTCUSDT, not consolidated BTCUSD.
